title: Malicious code in @zread/cli-darwin-arm64 (npm)
description: The npm package @zread/cli-darwin-arm64 contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of the malicious software or attacker control.
